changes.new_notice: The asserted two-fan equality is false. P3K.65 constructs the full negative-to-positive native Cox comparison and gives classes -3k and 0 for the positive r-loop, and -k and 0 for the actual shorter w-loop. At k=1 the original negative fan has classes 25 and 27, respectively. The omitted second outer map has positive-normal determinant winding -2m; the first outer map is the identity. The local charged-cap construction is retained with its full outer marking.

The asserted all-shear equality is false. In the explicitly constructed primitive OS45 family of P3K.10/P3K.22, the actual scalar loop has J=1 and reference class -3. P3K.64 gives class -4 on T_2, whose directions are e_2,(1,2),(1,1). The direct initial/reflected C2 equality remains the narrow comparison proved in P3K.62. The outer C1 determinant has the previously omitted winding -2J.

The claimed simultaneous marked delta-equivariant plumbing product does not exist for nonzero scalar winding J: P3K.61 derives the incompatible determinant equation -J=0. In the actual native C1 product, P3K.62 gives the single free pair (J,-J), contradicting the stated zero right coefficient at J=1. The integral cells, common-exterior bases, dual maps, symmetry and exact local frame-change identity remain valid in their displayed markings.

The universal fan polynomial is false. The primitive OS45 family of P3K.10/P3K.22 has reference class -3 and scalar winding J=1. On the actual T_2 fan, delta has coordinates (0,1), so the displayed S formula still gives -3; P3K.64 constructs the full maps and proves the value -4. The single-star product-frame, boundary flop and complex normal reset maps are retained; the scalar initial data and universal formula are withdrawn.

The universal OS49 fan formula is false. For k=1 the original negative-diagonal fan has S=1 in its primitive H/K marking, so the displayed formula gives 0; P3K.65 proves the actual positive r-loop class -3. The independently constructed positive-fan page and its zero index are retained. P3K.65 also proves the actual shorter negative-fan class -k, with positive-fan class 0; no negative-fan integer is assigned.
